question: Which interface can carry the frozen read's evidence into the byte path when the answer class is not handed over as a code?

options.A: fixed evidence projection: corrected per-column logits -> fixed projection -> joint_readout
options.B: trainable read adapter: corrected per-column logits -> learned adapter -> joint_readout
options.C: read-as-teacher distillation: the body's own x must carry the read class, then the byte head is trained on the real context

measurements: read class decodable from the body's own x at prefix 0 (48 dims, both branches), train64 -> fit32
read class decodable from x pooled over all prefixes
read class decodable per prefix position 0..6
read class decodable from the 128-dim column tokens as the reference ceiling
per-column palette colour decodable from x at prefix 0 (secondary)
label-shuffle null for the primary probe

decision.primary: x at prefix position 0, 48 dims, trained on train64 and tested on fit32
decision.reference: 16x8 column tokens flattened to 128 dims, same split
decision.probe: standardized closed-form linear ridge and RBF kernel ridge; no iterative training
decision.label: frozen calibrated read class (left/middle/right/unknown)
decision.rule: null_max > 0.35 -> probe_unreliable; max(linear, rbf) >= 0.80 -> interface_decodable; >= 0.40 -> interface_partially_decodable; else interface_not_decodable

scope: zero-training interface review with closed-form probes only; no subject update, no checkpoint, no capability or parent claim

review_facts.fact: prefix-0 class probe 14/32 = 0.4375 against a shuffle null of 0.34375 and a column-token reference of 0.375
review_facts.implication: the 0.40 partial branch is a coarse-threshold false positive; the decision point is at chance

review_facts.fact: prefixes 1-6 rise to 0.81-1.0 because the emission cache is teacher-forced with the target bytes
review_facts.implication: later-prefix decodability is target-prefix leakage, not a scene read

review_facts.fact: the painted-column colour probe from x at prefix 0 is 0.0154 (background 0.963)
review_facts.implication: the body's x does not carry the requested colour columns at decision time

criteria_flaw: the review rule accepted max(linear, rbf) >= 0.40 without a minimum margin over the null or the reference; the next review must require an effect of at least 0.20 over the shuffle null, a painted-colour probe of at least 0.50 at prefix 0, and prefix 0 only
